Final for Publication

File Number: 23037-T1
17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Substitute Narrative & Plans ~ 1928 North Lincoln Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: § RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,326.20 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is keeping the existing two-story residential building
containing two (2) dwelling units. The plan is to rehabilitate the existing
building, construct a two-story rear addition and two-car garage with a
rooftop deck. The addition will have a height of 28 ft.-1 inch, Pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear yard open space from
the required 151.20 SF to 128 SF; front setback from the required 13.08” to
6’; tear setback from the required 32.7’ to 12’-8 A”; combined side setback
from the required 8.12’ to 0’; reduce the north side setback from the
required 4.06’ to 0” (with south side setback of 0°); and all relief necessary,
as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,954.7 square feet (1.70 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,163.1 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2

(D) Setbacks:

a. Front Setback: 6
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 0”
South Side: 0”
c. Rear Setback: 12’-8 4”

(E) Building Height: 28°-1”
